definition.def: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.
examples: There was total agreement to start the peace process as soon as possible.
They decided to spread the building process over three years.
The best way to proceed is by a process of elimination. [+ of]

definition.def: A process is a series of things which happen naturally and result in a biological or chemical change.
examples: It occurs in elderly men, apparently as part of the ageing process.
The regularity with which this occurs suggests that the process is genetically determined.

definition.def: When raw materials or foods are processed, they are prepared in factories before they are used or sold.
examples: ...fish which are processed by freezing, canning or smoking. [be VERB-ed]
The material will be processed into plastic pellets. [be VERB-ed + into]
...diets high in refined and processed foods. [VERB-ed]

definition.def: When people process information, they put it through a system or into a computer in order to deal with it.
examples: ...facilities to process the data, and the right to publish the results. [VERB noun]
The information gathered by the telescopes will be processed by computers. [VERB noun]

definition.def: When people are processed by officials, their case is dealt with in stages and they pass from one stage of the process to the next.
examples: Patients took more than two hours to be processed through the department. [be VERB-ed]

definition.def: If you are in the process of doing something, you have started to do it and are still doing it.
examples: The administration is in the process of drawing up a peace plan.
Her novel is in the process of being turned into a television series.

definition.def: If you are doing something and you do something else in the process, you do the second thing as part of doing the first thing.
examples: He finished ahead of the Spaniard, and in the process picked up his first time trial win as a pro.
You have to let us struggle for ourselves, even if we must die in the process.
